errors: On Linux/POSIX, process.stdout writes are asynchronous when stdout is a pipe, not synchronous as claimed. Writes to regular files and TTYs are synchronous; slow Docker/k8s pipe consumers can cause backpressure without each write directly blocking the event loop.
Multiple Winston transports do not necessarily each repeat formatting. Logger-level formatting runs before dispatch to transports; additional per-transport formatting occurs only when configured.
